use.zh-CN: 重复记录固定位置围度
use.en: Repeats circumference at a fixed site

caution.zh-CN: 位置、松紧和呼吸状态一致
caution.en: Keep site, tension and breathing phase consistent

evidenceScope.zh-CN: 前者为特定体脂秤验证，后者说明结局指标区分；不构成所有监测设备的精度验证。
evidenceScope.en: One validates specific BIA scales; the other distinguishes body-composition outcomes. These do not validate all monitors.
